case.title: Exactly two other same-day submissions about 44.5 m away fire same_spot

submissions.open_text: Household complains about long queues at the kiosk near the market every morning.
Mother of four says the borehole broke last month and repairs took weeks.
Elderly man stores rainwater in drums and boils it before drinking.

case.why: Probes the 'at least 2' count. n1 is 0.0004 deg of latitude north of t (about 44.5 m). n2 is 0.0004 deg of longitude east, which at latitude -0.08 is also about 44.5 m. Both are under 50 m and on the same local day, 2024-03-12. So t has exactly 2 qualifying neighbours and must fire. An implementation that needs more than 2 neighbours (using > instead of >=) would stay silent. So would one that needs 3 points including t to all sit inside one fixed cell. The three times are 09:00, 11:00 and 14:30, so there is no burst. All points are inside Kondele and all durations are at least 23 minutes.
